topic: Sampling Flavors at an Ice-Cream Shop

script.title: ICE CREAM SAMPLING
script.story_hook: Choosing a flavor is harder than it looks.
script.welcome_en: Hello, sunshine! Today we beat the heat with ice cream.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，大太陽！今天我們用冰淇淋消暑。
script.outro: Sweet problem, sweet fix. Which flavor would you pick?
script.outro_zh: 甜甜的麻煩，甜甜的解決。你會選哪種口味？
script.practice_intro_en: Say each line after the audio now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著語音逐句朗讀。
script.char_a_description: A cheerful dad in his early thirties with a short buzz cut, wire glasses, a sky-blue polo shirt, khaki shorts, and a shoulder bag, holding a small child's hand.
script.char_b_description: A teenage girl of seventeen with a high mint-colored ponytail, light freckles, a pastel pink staff shirt, and a paper cone hat, smiling behind the counter.
script.thumbnail_expression: staring hopelessly at the flavor case

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew, it is boiling out there today.
dialogue.phonetic: /fjuː, ɪt ɪz ˈbɔɪlɪŋ aʊð ˈðɛr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 呼，今天外面熱得要命。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right? The shop is packed this afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt? ðə ʃɑp ɪz pækt ðɪs ˌæftɚˈnuːn/
dialogue.zh: 是吧？今天下午店內擠滿了人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect weather for ice cream, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːɹfɪkt ˈwɛðɚ fɔɹ ˈaɪs ˌkɹim, ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，這天氣太適合吃冰淇淋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what everyone says at three o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wʌt ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn ˈsɛz æt θɹi əˈklɑk/
dialogue.zh: 三點鐘的時候每個人都這麼說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how many free samples are allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, haʊ ˈmɛni ˈfɹi ˈsæmpəlz ɑɹ əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 請問，免費試吃可以試幾勺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three spoons, no problem. Which ones?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi spunz, noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm. wɪtʃ wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 三勺，沒問題。想試哪幾種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the salted caramel and the matcha.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm, ðə ˈsɔːltəd ˈkɑɹəməl ænd ðə ˈmætʃə/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，海鹽焦糖和抹茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good picks. What's the third one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɪks. wʌts ðə θɜːɹd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇。第三種要哪一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe your cookies and cream today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi jɔːɹ ˈkʊkiz ænd ˈkɹim təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 再來你們的餅乾奶油口味吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, one spoon for each.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ, wʌn spun fɔɹ itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 給您，每種口味各一勺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the matcha is smooth, not bitter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ, ðə ˈmætʃə ɪz smuːð, nɑt ˈbɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這抹茶很滑順，不苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hear that a lot, it's mild.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hɪɹ ðæt ə ˈlɑt, ɪs ˈmaɪld/
dialogue.zh: 我們常聽到這句話，它的味道溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this caramel tastes like real butter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðɪs ˈkɑɹəməl ˈteɪsts ˈlaɪk ɹiːl ˈbʌtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這焦糖吃起來像真正的奶油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, from a small local dairy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz, fɹəm ə smɑːl ˈloʊkəl ˈdɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 是呀，奶源來自當地的小牧場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — what did my little helper choose?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt — wʌt dɪd maɪ ˈlɪtəl ˈhɛlpɚ tʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 等等——我的小幫手選了哪一種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! He pointed at strawberry twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ! hi ˈpɔɪntɪd æt ˈstɹɔːbɚi ˈtwaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哈！他指了兩次草莓口味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then strawberry it is, little buddy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈstɹɔːbɚi ɪt ɪz, ˈlɪtəl ˈbʌdi/
dialogue.zh: 那就草莓囉，小夥計。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids' cups are half price, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz kʌps ɑɹ hæf pɹaɪs, baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，小朋友的杯子都是半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Now, cone or cup for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs. naʊ, koʊn ɔɹ kʌp fɔɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。那我要甜筒還是杯子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cones taste better, cups travel better.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊnz ˈteɪst ˈbɛtɚ, kʌps ˈtɹævəl ˈbɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 甜筒吃起來更香，杯子更適合帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good point, we still have a walk back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɔɪnt, wi stɪl hæv ə wɑːk bæk/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，我們還要走一段路才到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a cup? The waffle cone costs extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə kʌp? ðə ˈwɑːfəl koʊn kɔsts ˈɛkstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那要用杯子？蛋捲筒要另加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much extra, if you don't mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈɛkstɚ, ɪf ju ˈdoʊnt maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 不介意的話，差價是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only fifty cents, and it's freshly baked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈfɪfti sɛnts, ænd ɪts ˈfɹɛʃli beɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 只要五十美分，而且是現烤的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, no temptations today, the cup please.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ, noʊ tɛmpˈteɪʃənz təˈdeɪ, ðə kʌp pliz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，今天不上當，請用杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. One big scoop, or two small?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑːɹt. wʌn bɪɡ skup, ɔɹ tu smɑl/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。要一大勺，還是兩小勺？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two, matcha and caramel, split evenly.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː, ˈmætʃə ænd ˈkɑɹəməl, splɪt ˈivənli/
dialogue.zh: 兩勺，抹茶和焦糖，各一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming up. And for the little guy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ ʌp. ænd fɔɹ ðə ˈlɪtəl ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 馬上來。小朋友要什麼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just strawberry, a small one, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈstɹɔːbɚi, ə smɔːl wʌn, pliz/
dialogue.zh: 只要草莓，小杯就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sprinkles or a candy topper for him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsprɪŋkəlz ɔɹ ə ˈkændi ˈtɑpɚ fɔɹ hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 他要撒糖針還是糖果裝飾？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh man, whatever keeps the peace here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ mæn, wʌtˈɛvɚ ˈkiːps ðə pis hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，只要能讓他乖乖的就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rainbow sprinkles, then — he's nodding yes!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹeɪnˌboʊ ˈsprɪŋkəlz, ðɛn — hiz ˈnɑdɪŋ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 那就彩虹糖針——他點頭說要了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! He smiles when sugar is involved.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil! hi smaɪlz wɛn ˈʃʊɡɚ ɪz ɪnˈvɑlst/
dialogue.zh: 成交！一有糖他就笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There they are, two cups, extra napkins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ðeɪ ɑɹ, tu kʌps, ˈɛkstɚ ˈnæpkɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 兩杯好了，還多給你紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks — whoa, my scoop just slid off!
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks — woʊ, maɪ skup dʒʌst slɪd ɔːf/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝——哇，我那勺剛滑下來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, the floor got it, didn't it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ, ðə flɔː ɡɑt ɪt, ˈdɪdənt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，全都掉地上了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yep, right onto my shoe, fantastic.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp, ɹaɪt ˈɑntu maɪ ʃuː, fænˈtæstɪk/
dialogue.zh: 對，正落在我的鞋上，真是太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm so sorry! The second one is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈsoʊ ˈsɑɹi! ðə ˈsɛkʌnd wʌn ɪz ˈfɹi/
dialogue.zh: 真抱歉！第二杯免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? You didn't have to, but thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli? ju ˈdɪdənt hæv tə, bʌt θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？不用這樣，但謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens ten times a day, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz tɛn ˈtaɪmz ə deɪ, ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，一天總要發生個十次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At least my shoes are sweet now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ət list maɪ ʃuz ɑɹ swit naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 至少我的鞋現在變甜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Here's a wet wipe for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ! hɪɹz ə wɛt waɪp fɔɹ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這有濕紙巾給您擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lifesaver. Okay, replacement matcha, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ. ˈoʊkeɪ, ɹɪˈpleɪsmənt ˈmætʃə, pliz/
dialogue.zh: 真是救星。好，請換一杯抹茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bigger scoop this time, and it's covered.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪɡɚ skup ðɪs ˈtaɪm, ænd ɪts ˈkʌvɚd/
dialogue.zh: 這勺會更大，這杯我們招待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're too kind. What do I owe you?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ tu kaɪnd. wʌt du aɪ ˈoʊ ju/
dialogue.zh: 你們太好了。共多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That'll be nine twenty-five for everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðætl bi naɪn ˈtwɛnti faɪv fɔɹ ˈɛvɹiˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一共是九塊二毛五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, please. Is the tip screen optional?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑːɹd, pliz. ɪz ðə tɪp skɹin ˈɑːpʃənl/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡。畫面上的小費可以跳過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fully optional, no pressure at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʊli ˈɑːpʃənl, noʊ ˈpɹɛʃɚ ət ɔːl/
dialogue.zh: 完全可以自由選擇，沒有壓力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're tipping, the service deserved it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹ ˈtɪpɪŋ, ðə ˈsɜːɹvɪz dɪˈzɜːɹvd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們要給小費，這服務值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aw, thank you! There's a shaded bench by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ, ˈθæŋk ju! ðɛrz ə ˈʃeɪdɪd bɛntʃ baɪ ðə dɔːɹ/
dialogue.zh: 謝啦！門口有張陰涼的長椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great idea, the sun is getting lower.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪˈdiə, ðə sʌn ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈloʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好主意，太陽也慢慢偏西了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best time for a slow ice cream walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst taɪm fɔɹ ə sloʊ ˈaɪs ˌkɹim wɑːk/
dialogue.zh: 最適合拿著冰淇淋慢慢散步了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly what a hot day needs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt ə hɑt deɪ niːdz/
dialogue.zh: 正是大熱天最需要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little guy can come back anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl ɡaɪ kæn kʌm bæk ˈɛniˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 隨時歡迎小朋友再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'd love that. Same time next week?
dialogue.phonetic: /hid lʌv ðæt. seɪm taɪm nɛkst wik/
dialogue.zh: 他一定很開心。下週同一時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll be here, and Tuesday means double scoops.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil bi hɪɹ, ænd ˈtuzˌdeɪ minz ˈdəbəl spans/
dialogue.zh: 我們都在，而且週二勺量雙倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Double scoops? Put me down for Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdəbəl spans? pʊt mi daʊn fɔɹ ˈtuzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 雙倍？週二也算我一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! See you and your crew then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ! ˈsi ju ænd jɔːɹ kɹu ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！那到時候見你們全家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the patience, and the free fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔɹ ðə ˈpeɪʃənz, ænd ðə ˈfɹi fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的耐心，還有免費補的那杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Enjoy your afternoon, stay cool!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm! ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔːɹ ˌæftɚˈnuːn,-steɪ ˈkul/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！享受午後，保持涼快！

script.youtube_title_en: "The Second One Is Free" - Sampling Flavors at an Ice-Cream Shop
script.youtube_description:
抹茶還是海鹽焦糖？在冰淇淋店挑到舉棋不定，該怎麼請店員試吃？這集60句沉浸式英文聽力，帶你度過一個甜甜的午後。

劇情：一位爸爸帶著小孩光臨人潮滿滿的冰淇淋店，先要了三勺試吃，再糾結甜筒還是杯子。沒想到第一大球滑到鞋上，店員送來免費替換杯，還聊起半價兒童杯、雙倍勺的週二與門口長椅。

你將學習：
- 用 How many free samples are allowed? 詢問試吃規則
- 用 cone or cup 與 costs extra 討論選擇與加價
- 物品掉落時的安慰與免費互換說法

每句都附國際音標與繁中翻譯，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能開口用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
記得訂閱頻道、開啟小鈴鐺，每天一集沉浸式英文！
script.youtube_description_en:
Matcha or salted caramel? In this 60-line immersive English listening lesson, a dad and his little kid walk into a packed ice-cream shop, sample three spoons, debate cone versus cup, and turn a dropped scoop into a free second chance.

You will learn to:
- Ask how many free samples are allowed
- Choose between cone or cup and ask about extras
- Handle a small mishap politely and thank the staff

Every line is short and clear for A2 learners, with IPA and translations, plus a line-by-line repeat section.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new immersive listening quest every week!

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
站在冰淇淋櫃前走不動路，想試吃又怕尷尬，該怎麼用英文開口？
這一集帶大家走進夏日午後人潮滿滿的冰淇淋店，看一位爸爸帶著小朋友試吃、選杯，還把掉落的冰淇淋變成一杯免費的驚喜。
你會聽到：
- 🥄 「How many free samples are allowed?」— 詢問試吃規則的客氣問法。
- 🍦 「Cone or cup for me?」— 甜筒與杯子怎麼選。
- 😅 「The second one is free.」— 掉了之後店家的暖心應對。
- 💳 「Is the tip screen optional?」— 刷卡時小費畫面的問法。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧，每句十詞以內，慢速清楚，讓你聽了就想跟著唸。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
願你的夏天，永遠有一勺剛剛好的甜！
